summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted electively for high-dose cyclophosphamide chemotherapy as part of stem cell mobilization for multiple myeloma treatment. He tolerated the chemotherapy well without acute adverse events, nausea, or complications. His insulin regimen was adjusted downward following discontinuation of dexamethasone, with guidance from the endocrine service. Coumadin was held due to anticipated thrombocytopenia from chemotherapy. Lamivudine was initiated for hepatitis B reactivation prophylaxis given a positive core antibody. He was discharged home the following day with instructions to start Neupogen and ciprofloxacin, continue adjusted diabetes medications, and hold anticoagulation until further guidance from his oncologist.
problems: Multiple myeloma, without mention of having achieved remission
Personal history of venous thrombosis and embolism
Other and unspecified alcohol dependence, unspecified
